about_the_game:
MEET RAVENNA!

Meet Ravenna — the mysterious loner from the Wasteland. A black cloak, a plague doctor mask, vintage stockings and gloves, and a leather corset trimmed with frills — every detail of her outfit oozes intoxicating sensuality.

Ravenna is insatiable when it comes to sex — she can go for hours. Always hungry for new sensations, she eagerly agrees to all kinds of experiments, whether it's playful voyeurism, temperature play, or something even spicier. All it takes is one desire, and Ravenna will poison you with passion, only to heal you with kisses and caresses.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

By purchasing this DLC, you unlock Ravenna in her plague muse look. You can change your mascot at any time by opening your profile in-game and selecting the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
